## Changes

- Add read-only Obsidian tools to new persistent threads, starting with wikilink resolution.
- Update compatibility for Codex CLI 0.150.1, with clearer terminal-input approvals and accurate completed subagent activity.
- Report current MCP server connection and authentication issues in diagnostics.
- Prevent configured MCP servers and other Codex tools from interfering with automatic thread naming and Selection Rewrite, and keep auto-name cancellation visible while it runs.
